name: BACH_0097
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged tier-2 priority [F1] with unanimous model and neighbor support; ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Single dominant diagnostic class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha, 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (80%–83% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest embedding signal (+1.82 contribution; 19/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Second-largest push (+1.12); failed AI spot checks (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-1.11) pushes toward invasion (+0.86); caption-inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.39 contribution; 18/20 AI spot check) · Validated
- **Segmented nuclei metrics** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · 88% neoplastic [F7], 100th-percentile size [F8], 90th-percentile shape variation [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (diff +0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); case leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade in situ carcinoma mimics invasion; contrast case BACH_0013 (InSitu, 72% similarity) differs in tubules and Unreliable mitoses.
- Unusual tissue appearance (94th OOD percentile) misleads the classifier, validated on 132 test images across 24 patients.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 3**: Confirm true stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma, especially around scarce tubules in region 0.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 8**: Manually assess mitotic activity and necrosis (region 8); both concept detectors are Unreliable.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: Verify segmented nuclear pleomorphism and tumor cellularity before approving drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders.
